Workshop help

Support

How to play

  1. Look for the supports holding up the gold crown.
  2. Drag to aim, then release your one fixed-power shot. You can enable the aim pad in Settings.
  3. Land the crown on the marked catch floor. If you miss, tap Try Again. Retries are free.

First-level guidance stays available until that level is cleared. Later play keeps the board clear.

Progress and saved builds

Campaign progress, settings and your saved local remix live on this device. There is no game account or cloud-save service. Removing the app and its data may remove that progress; reinstalling does not guarantee restoration. The planned public version 1.0.0 (3) also saves earned Bolts and cosmetic choices locally.

Advertising by version

The planned public version 1.0.0 (3) has live advertising disabled and has no Test ads panel. In that version, Settings → Privacy & help shows links to this support page and the privacy policy. It is still being prepared for release.

The separate TestFlight beta 0.1.1 (2) includes an optional preview in Settings → Test ads. Choose a format, tap Load, then Show. These are Google sample ads. A test reward does not add game currency. You never need an ad to play or retry.

If loading fails, you can return to the game. If an ad or privacy form has visibly closed but the test panel remains stuck, the panel offers Reset test session after two minutes.

Report a problem

A parent, guardian or adult player can email relativityrush@gmail.com with “Break My Build” in the subject. Include the app version, level number, device model and what happened. A screenshot can help. Please do not include passwords, bank details or verification codes.
